overview: This Senate resolution condemns the assassination of Charlie Kirk, the founder of the conservative campus group Turning Point USA, who was killed on September 10, 2025, while speaking to college students at Utah Valley University. It describes him as a husband, father and Christian who often debated students of all political backgrounds. The resolution condemns the killing in the strongest terms, offers condolences to his wife and two young children, and honors his commitment to civil discussion and debate among all Americans regardless of political affiliation. The Senate adopted it by unanimous consent on September 16, 2025.
for: Supporters say the Senate should speak with one voice against political violence and honor a person killed while engaging in public debate.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or take any concrete steps to prevent political violence.
